𝗛𝗢𝗪 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗔𝗦𝗛𝗘𝗦 𝗕𝗘𝗚𝗔𝗡 ⚰️🏏

The Oval, 1882: Australia beat England by 7 runs.
A newspaper printed a mock obituary of English cricket, saying 'the ashes' would go to Australia. 🔥

#Cricket #Ashes
